lanes.label: Mobile Phone Lane
lanes.note: Förvald lane. Sparat gameLanes-register kan få fler versionerade porträttlanes för samma verifierade mediesamling; gameLane väljer aktiv lane. Sista lane kan tas bort till null, vilket stänger ny Blackjack-start.

steps: Dealer & klipp edits an unsaved browser draft
Live admin and scope validation, media-binding validation, transaction and CAS
Saved Neon revision and history become the shared game-policy source
Deal/reply choices apply at the next decision; idle/original choices require game reload between hands
Admin handler validates lane and saves administration.gameLane with CAS
Clean /blackjack checks player session and reads saved /api/bo/config
gameLaneSelection resolves saved lane or explicit allowed legacy selectors
Game HTML receives data-game-lane, data-game-dealer and data-game-presentation

importantUnknowns: No live routes, deployment flags, current saved lane, login, media playback or save operations were verified during this task.
Configured origins are environment-dependent; public/local origins above are documentation references.
Tests listed are existing source references, not test-run results from this task.
Native admin endpoint descriptors only become available when their handler and every extra gate are registered.
Current code has 15 admin sections including lanes; guide text still describes 14 existing functions.
Background-zone editor/cloud save does not establish game integration.
Exact Render gateway internals and every API/provider gate were not exhaustively mapped.

sourceRouteCatalog.pathConvention: path is the URL pattern within the app, publicPath uses the documented /studio Lab mount. :id denotes one segment, :path+ required catch-all, :path* optional catch-all.
sourceRouteCatalog.methodConvention: methods lists only HTTP verbs explicitly exported by route.ts. Next page components have methods=[]; implicit framework HEAD/OPTIONS and unsupported verbs are not inferred.
sourceRouteCatalog.servingConvention: Services describe platform routing with native Studio enabled in existing code, with conditional legacy/local branches stated. Source file existence does not prove a handler is reached on a deployed public origin.
caveats: No deployed route, live authorization, native browser UI or provider was exercised for this catalog.
Historical alias route files are marked historicalAlias and remain distinct from their redirect target; no extra QA-query rows duplicate a file.

Manually registered web server routes, native Node WebSocket endpoints outside app and framework-generated assets are covered by existing groups only; this bounded file catalog is not an exhaustive server-regex inventory.
Source SHA is managed by the coordinating agent after the code commit.
